label: Irregular nebula transfer experiments

catalogueSource.query: SELECT ident.id,basic.main_id,basic.ra,basic.dec,basic.otype,basic.coo_bibcode FROM basic JOIN ident ON basic.oid=ident.oidref WHERE ident.id IN ('M 42','M 8','NGC 3372','NGC 6357','M 78','Barnard 33')
catalogueSource.interpretation: Six selected catalogue identities, not a full all-sky catalogue. ICRS/J2000 object centres identify the target; image registration uses the publisher's image WCS. SIMBAD classifies the M8 and NGC6357 entries as open clusters; the ESO images depict their surrounding nebular complexes. Preserve this distinction.

method: Image-only positive relative-emission fit with conditional depth; no planetary expansion or Helix geometry prior is transferred.
